name: iFizBox
subtitle: A package manager with the iOS 6 look
description: iFizBox's own source: the iFizBox app for iPhones without a jailbreak.

apps.name: iFizBox
apps.subtitle: Packages and apps with the iOS 6 look
apps.localizedDescription: iFizBox lists apps from AltStore-style sources and, on a jailbroken iPhone, tweaks and themes from APT repos, with the iOS 6 look. The app signs apps on your iPhone with your own certificate (no server) and scrolls at 120Hz. Free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later).

versions.localizedDescription:
Paid packages from Havoc and Chariz with capital letters in their ID, such as EchoUI or Lyre, show their price and Buy instead of Not Found.
In the sideload app (without a jailbreak), someone who bought a paid tweak its seller no longer sells can now sign in and add it to an app.
In Browse, choosing another Sort in Filter no longer changes the width of the buttons at the top, and the A–Z index starts below them.
In lists sorted by name in Browse, the A–Z index now goes all the way back to the top, and lands on the letter you touch.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.35.0

Browse's New and Top 25 now have a Filter button.
The iOS 26 app icon is darker on a dark Home Screen.
Search keeps the keyboard up when you pick a category.
Browse's New and Top 25 have a Filter button, to filter and sort them as you can the other lists.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.34.0

Hide an install run and follow it in a strip under the bar.
Restore My VPN asks before turning your VPN back on.
iFizBox's own update finishes by itself, with no swipe.
Browse lists get Search's scope bar, Filter and sorting.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.33.0

Pairing on This iPhone now stops by itself.
Install bars show stripes while iOS gets ready.
Tweak sources YTLite and SCInsta no longer pre-added.
A stuck update now tells you what to do.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.32.0

Restore My VPN turns your own VPN back on after installs.
Install several IPAs at once from Confirm, up to three together.
Cellular installs can use a Shortcut or your Signing Server.
Notification fixes for tweaked apps such as RyukGram.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.31.0

Installing an app through iOS now shows its real progress.
The jailbreak app says Preparing until an install starts.
Installing an app now says Uploading, Handing to iOS, or Waiting for iOS until iOS actually starts installing, and the jailbreak app says Preparing until its install starts.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.30.0

Installing on This iPhone now says what it is doing at each step.
A lost pairing is spotted early, with a Fix and Pair Again.
Home shows a Pair This iPhone tile until you pair.
Restore My VPN brings your own VPN back after installs.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.29.0

On cellular, installs ask for Airplane Mode after signing.
Install on an app's page goes straight to the queue.
Confirm runs apps and tweaks together in one go.
Apps signed here no longer crash when started while locked.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.28.0

Updates no longer bounce between iFizBox and Shortcuts.
Updating iFizBox by Signing Server no longer gets stuck.
Add Tweaks now queues the app too.
An older Install Switch is offered its update.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.27.0

Install Switch opens Shortcuts once per install queue.
Swipe between Details, Reviews and Related.
Hold Install to queue an update straight away.
Apps waiting their turn show a moving bar.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.26.0

Share opens each style's own menu
Install Switch opens only when it's needed
Installs on cellular with the Install Switch
Fewer system-only tweaks in App Tweaks
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.25.0

Install Switch reconnects your VPN more reliably
Install Switch no longer stops early on iOS 27 when it reconnects your own VPN after an install, so its next run starts clean.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.24.1

Install Switch: one Shortcut for installs on cellular
Your own VPN comes back after installs
An IPA's page looks like an app's Details page
Add Tweaks opens as a page you can swipe back from
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.24.0

Source Filters hide old, paid or unknown-iOS packages
One page layout for every source
Built-in VPN set up once, tested by itself
Custom installs are kept in My IPAs
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.23.0

Sideload app: a built-in VPN for This iPhone installs
Re-signed apps keep their logins: re-sign them once
Swipe back from anywhere on a page
What's New on top of Details when an update is out
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.22.0

A real iOS 26 tab bar, era icon sets, and era app icons with dark modes
iOS 26 style on iOS 26+: the tab bar is iOS's own, with its press-drag lens and shrink on scroll
iOS 13 and iOS 26 styles get their own icon sets for rows, tabs and Home
Theme > App Icon has iOS 7, iOS 13 and iOS 26 icons that turn dark with the Home Screen
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.21.0

Real Liquid Glass bars on iOS 26+, and Open Tailscale without the "Could not sign device" sheet
iOS 26 style in the app on iOS 26+: the tab bar, Search circle and bar buttons are iOS's own Liquid Glass
Open Tailscale opens the app directly instead of Tailscale's "Could not sign device" sheet
iOS 26 style in the app on iOS 26+: the floating tab bar, the Search circle and the nav bar's buttons are drawn by iOS as real Liquid Glass, with its refraction, over the page.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.20.1

iOS 26 style with native controls, Add Tweaks, and installs that fall back to the Signing Server
Theme > Style iOS 26: Liquid Glass bars, and in the app iOS's own switches, alerts, action sheets and scope bar
Add Tweaks page under an app's Details; Manage > Sources picks sources like Installed
This iPhone installs: Tailscale checked first, one pairing at a time, Use the Signing Server when it fails
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.20.0

Cydia-style Details page for packages and apps, and Source links that land on Sources
Packages and apps open a Details page like Cydia's: icon rows, Preview, More Information, Filesystem Content
Website add-source links open the Sources tab with the new source loading there
Home Screen icon follows Theme > Mode; Tailscale names the machine after the phone model
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.19.1

A Glass app icon, wide package rows like Cydia's, and steadier This iPhone copies
Theme > App Icon > Special offers Glass: Classic in Light, Gunmetal in Dark, drawn with the system's glass
Installed and section lists show wide package rows; Install IPAs is a plain row above A in Installed
Author pages open again; price buttons match the iOS 7 and iOS 13 themes
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.19.0
